rows.action: Owner setup, browser sign-in/out and session recovery
rows.authority: Interactive identity proof must not be delegated using an automation bearer credential.

rows.action: Provision Baikal credentials, authorize Google, disconnect grants
rows.authority: Fresh provider consent and secret entry remain interactive. Future delegated disconnect needs explicit consequential approval.

rows.action: Connector health and explicit Google sync/resync
rows.authority: Proposed separate connector read/recovery scopes; existing grant permissions must not widen.

rows.action: Day plan and planning preferences
rows.authority: Schedule reads and dedicated planning write scope; persisted revisions, preview and atomic confirmation. Browser PUTs invalidate old previews.

rows.action: Notification preferences, health and test delivery
rows.authority: Dedicated read/write/test scopes; redacted status and revisioned confirmation. Test confirmation atomically queues one delivery with its audit and replay receipt; worker delivery is separate and uncertain sends are terminal.

rows.action: Active and deleted task inventory
rows.authority: Catalog read scopes; owner filtering and recovery visibility.

rows.action: Plain or structured task capture
rows.authority: Preview resolves source input, including planned day and reminder settings, and rejects a planned day with an exact start; caller idempotency key binds one creation.

rows.action: Title, notes, dates, planned day, reminder and estimate edits
rows.authority: Exact expected task revision; atomic mutation/audit/receipt. Calendar-linked scheduling restrictions still apply: preview rejects a planned day while a calendar block exists and a deadline reminder without a timed deadline (ADR 0020).

rows.action: Complete and reopen tasks
rows.authority: Expected revision and replay receipt; task completion is distinct from focus completion.

rows.action: Delete and restore tasks
rows.authority: Explicit consequential approval, expected revision and focus/calendar deletion guards.

rows.action: Bounded planner and calendar projection
rows.authority: Schedule read scope, requested range, provider-qualified identities and visible freshness.

rows.action: Create, move and remove a task time block
rows.authority: Create tool exists; move/remove need provider conditional revisions, durable outcomes and explicit removal approval.

rows.action: Browser registration, cache snapshots and outbox transport
rows.authority: Browser client proof and immutable outbox remain internal; assistants use domain operations instead of pretending to be browser clients.

rows.action: Focus/break lifecycle and takeover
rows.authority: Server authoritative lease/revision; controller heartbeat is transport plumbing, not an additional user operation.

rows.action: Project and tag inventory
rows.authority: Catalog read scopes with owner-scoped records.

rows.action: Project/tag lifecycle, appearance, order, backlog and task assignment
rows.authority: Project/tag write scopes and task write scope; frozen revisions (every record for reorder), explicit preview confirmation, atomic sync/audit/replay. Completion archives; restore/reopen clears both.

rows.action: Project, tag and standalone notes: create, edit, pin, reorder and delete
rows.authority: Dedicated notes read/write scopes; owner-checked project/tag association, note revisions, complete-membership reorder and atomic audit/replay. Deletion is permanent and needs explicit approval. Notes are online-only.

rows.action: Task attachments and imported issue links: read, add/edit/remove link and note attachments, remove an issue link
rows.authority: Dedicated task_links read/write scopes; owner-checked task, attachment and issue-link revisions with atomic audit/replay. Only http(s) links without credentials are stored as openable. Previews name hosts, not full addresses. No operation contacts an issue provider; refresh or write-back needs a fresh provider authorization that does not exist yet. Online-only.

rows.action: Imported plugin data: list plugin IDs, keys, sizes and enabled flags; download an entry's data; delete an entry or enabled flag
rows.authority: Dedicated plugin_data:read scope lists identity, sizes and flags only; no assistant operation returns plugin data. Download and permanent deletion stay owner-only in the browser (session, CSRF and If-Match revisions). Nothing decodes or runs plugin data. Online-only (ADR 0026).

rows.action: Checklist child create/edit/reorder/delete
rows.authority: Task read/write scopes, owner-scoped checklist and parent revisions; exact reorder membership; atomic mutation, sync and confirmation receipt. Explicit approval for deletion/reorder.

rows.action: Create child tasks, move tasks between parents or to top level, reorder children
rows.authority: tasks:write; the preview freezes the task, target parent and every reordered child revision, and rejects depth, cycle and deleted-parent targets. The browser writes through the sync outbox (task.move), not api.ts. Hierarchy reads come from tasks.list parentId/childPosition.

rows.action: Search archived task history, archive a top-level task with its children, restore an archived family
rows.authority: tasks:read for owner-scoped history search with read-only import provenance; tasks:write for archive and restore. The preview freezes the parent and every child it moves; a changed or added child makes confirmation stale. Online-only in the browser (ADR 0022).

rows.action: List recurring series; create, edit, pause, resume and end a series; skip, restore or delete one occurrence
rows.authority: tasks:read for the owner-scoped series list with upcoming dates and exceptions; tasks:write for series and occurrence changes. Each preview freezes the series revision, and deleting an instance also freezes that task's revision. Generated instances are ordinary tasks changed with the task tools. Online-only in the browser (ADR 0023).

rows.action: Read the worklog by day, week, task and project; add, edit and delete manual time entries and imported daily totals
rows.authority: tasks:read for the owner-zone worklog report (at most 366 days); tasks:write for corrections. The preview freezes the entry revision, or the task revision and new entry ID for an addition; confirmation rechecks the 0 to 24 hour task-day bound and running focus. Focus entries and archived history are read-only. Online-only in the browser (ADR 0024).

rows.action: Read counter values with derived streaks; set, raise or lower a day's value; start and stop a stopwatch; create, edit and delete counters
rows.authority: metrics:read for owner-zone counter history (at most 366 days); metrics:write for writes. Day writes name the day revision read (0 when empty) and are rechecked at confirmation; definition edits, deletes and stopwatch start/stop freeze the counter revision. Deleting removes the counter's recorded days. Online-only in the browser (ADR 0025).

rows.action: Read daily evaluations with Tadooer focus per day; create or edit a day's evaluation
rows.authority: metrics:read for evaluations and derived focus over at most 366 days; metrics:write for writes, which name the evaluation revision read (0 for a new day). Imported focus session durations are read-only history (ADR 0025).

rows.action: Read and reorder the saved order of Today and each planned day; plan tasks for tomorrow
rows.authority: tasks:read for one date's order (the owner's planning date by default); tasks:write for a full-list reorder. A day order has no entity revision to freeze, so confirmation repeats the preview's day-order revision and exact-membership checks. Plan-for-tomorrow has no dedicated tool: the assistant sets planned days with tasks.update and then reorders. Online-only in the browser (ADR 0027).

rows.action: Template and set libraries
rows.authority: Catalog read scope and explicit library query semantics.

rows.action: Template authoring, archive, from-task and set creation
rows.authority: Library/source revisions, atomic membership and explicit archive approval.

rows.action: Instantiate a template or set
rows.authority: Freeze source revisions and destination; multi-task creation uses consequential approval policy.

rows.action: Choice pool library
rows.authority: Catalog read scope; eligibility and policy data are not new task state.

rows.action: Pool authoring, slots, completion history and placeholder creation/suggestion
rows.authority: History facts and explicit override audit must retain policy semantics and stable replay identities.

rows.action: Resolve a planning placeholder
rows.authority: Expected placeholder/source revisions; atomic task creation, history and consumed preview.

rows.action: Habit lifecycle, canonical completion and metrics
rows.authority: UI uses immutable sync commands; assistant preview binds habit revision and period completion deduplicates.

rows.action: Calendar import preview/apply
rows.authority: Read-only preview; reviewed provenance, exact target, permissions and retry-safe apply.

rows.action: Read-only calendar feed create/list/revoke
rows.authority: Capability creation/revocation is consequential; never expose capability secrets in logs or read resources.

rows.action: Super Productivity preview and reviewed apply
rows.authority: Hash-bound reviewed export, all-or-nothing transaction; real source export must not be echoed in tools.

rows.action: Issue/list/revoke scoped assistant credentials
rows.authority: An assistant may not mint broader credentials or grant itself permissions. Owner consent remains independent.

rows.action: Execute approved catalog preview
rows.authority: Confirmation resolves the stored operation scope; advertised write scopes are alternatives, not a demand for every scope. Approval policy and stale/replay checks remain server enforced.

rows.action: Remaining parity actions: boards and views, focus preferences, plugins and application settings
rows.authority: Add each new user action to this inventory as its domain slice is implemented. Dependencies: #63, #65, #66, #67. Hierarchy (#27), archived history (#38), work history (#41), recurrence (#42) and counters and evaluations (#64) have their own rows.

rows.action: Calendar mapping/conflict/background bridge controls
rows.authority: Require explicit mapped writable calendars and scoped consequential-action approval; no broad provider token reuse.

rows.action: Authenticated calendar ICS export
rows.authority: The UI downloads through an authenticated link outside api.ts; delegated export needs an explicit read scope and bounded content delivery.
